name: vlc-rec-neutralino
description: VLC Stream Recorder ported from Python Tkinter to NeutralinoJS

scripts.package: npm run build:player && neu build --release --embed-resources && node scripts/postpackage-linux-launchers.js
scripts.package:clean: npm run build:player && neu build --clean --release --embed-resources && node scripts/postpackage-linux-launchers.js
